correctness.rationale: For r≥3 positive parallel metric-edge lengths, the mean-zero H1 energy splits orthogonally into endpoint difference d with energy C d² (C=∑1/ℓ_i) and independent Dirichlet path fluctuations. Using the interval reproducing Green kernel gives exact evaluation diagonal K_i(s)=S3/(12L²)+(s/ℓ_i−1/2)²/C+s(ℓ_i−s)(1/ℓ_i−1/L). Its curvature is positive for r≥3 since (L−ℓ_i)∑_{j≠i}1/ℓ_j≥(r−1)²>1; maxima occur at midpoints and are ordered by ℓ_i(L−ℓ_i), hence longest paths. The sharp constant is S3/(12L²)+a(L−a)/(4L). For fixed L and r, Jensen plus monotonic Φ_r(x) gives the stated sharp minimum at equal lengths and the strict L/12 supremum. Independently checked K values 7/36 at lengths (1,1,1), 11/24 at (1,2,3), 5/24 at four unit paths, and 23/20 at (1,2,4,8).
